notes.title: Alpha Version Launch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/7143c28dbe69495cd9fe5fbe2f8d10ea94ec3b8d.png

Hello Arcane Hunters.
I finally managed to have a stable and playable version, far from being the final product but closer and closer. 

In this version I present the Book: Introduction to Arcanism.
This book contains important information about the occult universe.
How to collect evidence, a list of 15 creatures and more important information!

So far this is the list of creatures: 


 Gnome 
 Dragon 
 Unicorn 
 Fairy 
 Saber tooth 
 Ghost 
 Giant Spider 
 Mermaid 
 Phoenix
 ​Treant
 Headless Mule
 Werewolf
 Troll
 Gryffon
 Harpy


The equipment is extremely useful in your hunts, we currently have: 


 Compass 
 Watch 
 Grimoire
 Lamp 
 Arcane Crystal
 Spyglass
 Monocle


Observing the clues left by the creature it is possible to discover its species, we currently have 
 information about: 
 Mushrooms 
 Claw Mark 
 Footprint 
 Magic Dust 
 Scale 
 Bubbles 
 Fur 
 Feathers 
 Firemark
